blocks.tamil_translation: hears his voice, among creation living and lifeless, seeks forgiveness for him' In another narration it is stated, “All things living and lifeless respond to his Adhan.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ ﵁: إِذَا كُنْتَ فِي الْبَوَادِي فَارْفَعْ صَوْتَكَ بِالنِّدَاءِ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: لَا يَسْمَعُ صَوْتَهُ شَجَرٌ وَلَا مَدَرٌ وَلَا حَجَرٌ وَلَاجِنٌّ وَلَاإِنْسٌ إِلَّاشَهِدَ لَهُ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Sa'sa'ah (RA) says, Hazrat Abu Sa'id (RA) told (me), “When you are in the wilderness, call the Adhan in a loud voice. For I have heard the Prophet ﷺ say, “Every tree, clod of earth, stone, jinn and human that hears the sound of the Mu'adhdhin's Adhan will bear witness for him on the Day of Qiyamah.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ ﵄ أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّ اللهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَي الصَّفِّ الْمُقَدَّمِ، وَالْمُؤَذِّنُ يُغْفَرُ لَهُ بِمَدِّ صَوْتِهِ وَيُصَدِّقُهُ مَنْ سَمِعَهُ مِنْ رَطْبٍ وَّيَابِسٍ، وَلَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِ مَنْ صَلَّي مَعَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه النسائي باب رفع الصوت بالاذان رقم:٦٤٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Bara' ibn Azib (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “Indeed Allah showers His mercy upon those in the first row. The angels make Du'a for mercy for them. As far as the Mu'adhdhin's voice is heard, to that extent his sins are forgiven. All things living and lifeless that hear his voice confirm the truth of his words. Moreover, he will receive a reward equal to the reward received by all those who prayed along with him.”
